facts.business: Jindal Capital Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) engaged in lending and investment activities, generating revenue primarily from interest income and turnover from financial operations.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Borrowing limit approved by shareholders under Section 180(1)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Board's comments state: 'Observation made by the Statutory Auditors in their Report are self explanatory and therefore, do not call for any further comments under section 134(3)(f) of the Companies Act, 2013.'

key_risks: Revenues and expenses are difficult to predict and can vary significantly from period to period.
Success depends largely on management team and key personnel, and the ability to attract and retain them.
Changes in government regulations and tax structure.
Litigation, industrial relations, and other unforeseen events.
facts.related_party_note: Key managerial personnel (Sadhu Ram Aggarwal, Divya Aggarwal, Udit Aggarwal) are related: Sadhu Ram Aggarwal is father of Udit Aggarwal and father-in-law of Divya Aggarwal; Divya Aggarwal is wife of Udit Aggarwal. Both hold equity shares (9.71% and 8.32% respectively) and receive remuneration of Rs. 12,00,000 each.
